metadata.case_name: MAK SZE YING, FELIX v. CHUI CHAK YUNG T/A SILVER SPIRIT CAR SERVICES CENTER AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Dog bite injury to left hand and wrist
source: As he was picking up the car polishing machine, the 1st defendant’s dog (a Doberman Pinscher) bit the 1st defendant’s left hand and wrist, causing it to bleed and swell.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple open wounds of wrist or hand

injuries.description: Adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressed mood
source: Drs Lai and Ho agreed the plaintiff suffered from adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressed mood.

manifestations.description: numbness of left hand and wrist
inability to flex and extend the fingers in his left hand
left hand deformity in claw hand position
muscle wasting (mild) at the abductor pollicis brevis and marginal wasting at the first dorsal interosseous
reduced sensation to light touch over dorsum of left hand, dorsum of left fingers and left palm (percentages recorded in report)
stiffness of left finger flexors and stiffness of the left fingers and thumb
decreased temperature on the dorsum of the left hand
poor grip performance / inability to open fingers to grip
insomnia and nightmares of being bitten by a dog or other people with flashbacks

treatments_received: occupational therapy at Pok Oi Hospital (13 August 2008 to 23 October 2008)
physiotherapy for left hand (10 September to 15 October 2008) - 18 sessions
psychiatric follow-up at Tuen Mun Mental Health Centre and Castle Peak Hospital
treatments_future: further psychiatric treatments and marital therapy (recommended by psychiatrists/social workers)

losses.description: Reduced function of left hand and wrist including weakness, numbness, pain, inability to flex/extend fingers and reduced grip

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulties in lifting heavy objects using left hand, holding a teapot and wringing towels using left hand

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Prevented from engaging in outdoor sporting activities he used to enjoy and reduced ability when playing computer games
Plaintiff blamed the injury as an indirect cause of his divorce and marital breakdown
